Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 78 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 3351 of 2023 Applicant :- Mumtaj Ahamad Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pradeep Chauhan,Shiva Kant Srivastava Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant as well as learned A.G.A.
for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed with a prayer to release the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 330 of 2021, registered under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Jiyanpur, District Azamgarh, during pendency of the trial.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.

It is alleged in the F.I.R. that the applicant impostored himself as son of the owner of the property and mutated their name in revenue record,
thereafter, objection was filed by informant then his name was deleted from revenue record.
Allegation levelled against the applicant that he is Bhu Mafia and he fabricated documents and on that account mutated his name in the revenue record.
It is a civil nature dispute.

It is also submitted that co-accused persons Husaini Ansari and Chhotak @ Qayum have already been enlarged on bail vide orders dated 03.01.2023 and 13.01.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 49838 of 2022 and 51775 of 2022, respectively.

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal history in his credit.

Learned A.G.A., learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that the applicant is the main accused who has fabricated the documents and mutated his name in the revenue record, but could not dispute parity with co-accused who has been granted bail.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court inSatendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another,S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

Let the applicant, Mumtaj Ahamad, who is involved in the aforesaid caHeard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
